collection.name: Mars Cats Voyage
collection.summary: Unified rarity group for Mars Cats Voyage cats across Ethereum and ApeChain.

canonicalIdentity.notes: ETH and ApeChain records must resolve to one canonical token before ranking. Mirrored or bridged duplicates are excluded from scoring.

rarityScoring.notes: MCV 4-trait cats are structurally scarce. Trait Count rarity is used as a scarcity boost so the 173 four-trait cats are ranked as rare instead of being buried by average trait math.

formula.name: Trait-count scarcity boosted inverse frequency
formula.explanation: Each trait weight is collection supply divided by that trait occurrence count. Trait Count is measured by occurrence rarity and applied as a scarcity boost to the token's average trait weight. This collection uses a 0.33 exponent on Trait Count rarity, so structurally scarce low-trait-count tokens rank higher while individual trait rarity still orders tokens inside that group.
